sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Cycles through three weather effects while chipping away his health, then transforms into a harder Abomination form at 40%.

sections.heading: Weather phases
bullets: Heat Wave: punishes standing still with damage and periodic burning.
Downpour: pulsing group damage that stacks Unbalanced — don't let it stack too high.
Normal form cycles weather every 20% health lost; Abomination form (sub-40%) cycles every 30 seconds instead.

sections.heading: Sacrifice & corruption
bullets: Every 45s a random player is marked to be sacrificed in 10 seconds — break the defiance bar in time or that player dies.
Matthias fires Blood Shards — reflect them back to strip his protective stacks.
Corruption builds up on players and must be cleansed at one of four arena fountains — each fountain has a 100s cooldown after use, so don't all pile on one.
